changes.title: Exploratory study-retention time-to-event definition change
changes.description: Illustrative change to the TTDISC population, origin date, event/censor date, discontinuation event rule, censoring rule, Kaplan-Meier timepoints or exploratory pairwise survival-analysis specification.
changes.rationale: Tests whether a retention endpoint or survival-analysis change forces review of the controlled specification and documentation, ADTTE-style derivation, derivation/survival QC and both exploratory retention TLFs without propagating into the separate ACTOT confirmatory multiplicity family.
